segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey Jordan, quick gut check on Northline. I’m cleaning up the forecast and their expansion is still sitting at 12 seats, $18,720 annual, close date August 14.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, I saw that. They asked for 10 ops seats and 2 manager seats, right? Same package they already have, just adding the workflow module.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Correct. Their current agreement ends this Friday, and I don’t think anyone on our side has talked to them about carrying on yet, so I want to get the paper aligned before it gets weird.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Do they need a full order form or can we do the add-on quote from the pricing sheet?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Deal desk said full order form because the workflow module changes the product schedule. No legal redlines expected, but procurement wants the invoice split quarterly.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Quarterly is fine. Billing tool can do four invoices, first one on go-live. Did they confirm September 3 for go-live?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, September 3. They have training penciled in for September 5 and 6, six people per session. Customer success already has the kickoff template ready.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Not really. I put 8% in because that matches last year’s rate card exception. Total comes to $17,222 after discount, before taxes.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Works for me. Send me the order form before noon, I’ll do a quick pass, then you can send it to Kim and their finance alias.
